about: Move Catalog sprites for the Programmer. Text-free card frames, grid cards, states and family pictures. The game draws every word (see layout and moves-text.json). Sizes are 1x points; the @2x file is the same picture at twice the pixels. visibleRect and shadowMargin: each frame carries a 6 pt shadow margin, so the visible card starts 6 pt in. nineSlice is [top, right, bottom, left] in 1x px, as in menu2.json.
rule: No text is baked into any file. No red. Orange is not used. The card rim colour is the family colour.

menu2Refs.panel-inset: menu2 sprite: the cream inset box on the front (222 x 92) and the back (222 x 84). 9-slice from menu2.json.
menu2Refs.panel-frame: menu2 sprite: the Board paper panel the catalog grid sits in (536 x 340 on the 844 x 390 Board).
menu2Refs.tabs and chips: ui-benchmark/sprites/kit/tab-active and tab-normal (PR #412) for the Self-Defense / Kick Combos / Forms sub-tabs; ring-00..24 for the progress ring (8 of 40 = ring-05).

states.collected: mini/collected-{family}.png + family art + dojo name + game name
states.new: collected + mini/new-ribbon.png at the top-left (the NEW word is drawn by the game)
states.locked: mini/locked.png (family-neutral) + dojo name + the belt where the move is learned. No game name, no picture.
states.placeholder: big card only: card/inset-placeholder-front.png (front) or card/inset-placeholder-steps.png (back) instead of the cream inset

layout.units: points; origin is the top-left corner of the VISIBLE card (the file starts shadowMargin pt earlier)

inset.sprite: menu2 panel-inset (9-slice), or card/inset-placeholder when the words are not written

stepsArea.rowRule: row height = lines x (size x 1.16) + 5, at least 22

text.note: shrink from 13 to 12 pt to fit; if it still does not fit, scroll this area (moves with 5+ long steps)

dojoName.fit: shrink the size until it fits maxWidth, never below 7 pt

secondLine.collected: game name, colour = family rim darkened 42%
secondLine.locked: belt where learned, e.g. "Yellow Belt", colour #ceac7c

mini.lockedSeal: baked into mini/locked.png (40 pt, 9 pt below the top)

beltHeader.rule: 1.6 pt tan line #c49c6a from the end of the text to the right edge of the row

grid.grouping: by belt, five moves per belt (#1-5 White, #6-10 Yellow, #11-15 Orange, #16-20 Green, #21-25 Blue, #26-30 Red, #31-35 Red/Black, #36-40 Brown)
grid.headerRow: ring + "Move Catalog" 20 pt + "{n} of 40 moves collected" 13 pt; sub-tabs on the right

detail.frontBack: front card left, back card right, 96 pt apart (214 pt wide cards at scale 0.856); flip-arrow centred between them at y = 168; previous/next wood buttons 52 pt; close = menu2 sheet-close

text.gameName: game name under it (PB-06), only on cards that are not locked
text.frontLine: short "In the dojo:" line = the attack in Jay's table (Kick Combos: the list of kicks), then the "Flip for steps" chip
text.back: attack under IT STARTS WITH, numbered steps (moves-text.json, split at Jay's commas, no rewording), Jay's result under What happens:
text.lockedBelt: ui.sealLocked in seal-families-text.json = "{belt}" where belt is the full name, e.g. "Orange Belt"
text.placeholder: Moves with no words: draw "[PLACEHOLDER]" in dev builds; the player-facing wording is a DECIDE item

card/flip-chip.note: Gold chip with a play arrow at the right end, for "Flip for steps" (text drawn by the game, centred in the left 84 pt). 104 x 22 pt.

card/step-badge.note: Round gold badge for a step number (20 x 20 pt). The number is drawn by the game, 12 pt ExtraBold ink.

card/flip-arrow.note: Curved "tap to flip" arrow between the front and back in the detail view (84 x 56 pt). Cream with a soft shadow, on the dark scrim. The words "Tap to flip" are drawn by the game under it.
